title: Console global board - lanes columns rails and staleness
description: WHY: this is the human PM layer the original UX envisioned - a high-level live view of what is happening per project. WHAT: build the board view in apps/console on the aggregate rollup payload: project lanes with derived-status columns (draft, ready, in_progress, blocked, needs_verification, verified, closed collapsed sensibly for scanability), an Inbox rail (sprint G5 summary), a Next rail (sprint G6 queue), lifecycle-aware lane rendering (paused dimmed, missing flagged), and a staleness badge per lane driven by rollup generatedAt. Initiative lanes group portfolio containers with progress when sprint G7 data is present. Read-only in this task - interaction is the sibling task. Follow the existing console architecture: server provides CLI-contract JSON, components render, no client-side truth. Cover with the console component test patterns already in tests/runtime (console-components, console-smoke).
acceptanceCriteria: Board renders lanes, columns, both rails, staleness badges, and lifecycle states from fixture rollups, covered by component tests
A stale project lane is visibly marked and a missing project lane does not break the board
